notes.subject: לא אחריש בדיו
notes.rationale: JPS: 'mi no ken talai long ol tok swag bilong en' (Yahwe i tok); KJV/YLT: 'em bai mekim kontrak wantaim yu?' — tok i bruk long wanpela man

notes.subject: בד
notes.rationale: בד i save tok 'tok swag' o 'tok nogut'; dispela ples em i tok bilong Livyatan, olsem na 'tok swag'

translation: Mi no bai talai long ol tok swag bilong en; mi no bai talai tu long tok bilong ol strongpela wok, na ol gutpela kala bilong pasin bilong en.

tokens.gloss: long ol tok swag bilong en
